record.rationale: Browser ABI adapter reuses actual installed zip.js2.24.0 public dist/zip-module.wasm exports for synchronous zlib, original raw/wrapped initialization, Z_PARTIAL_FLUSH/status/consumption and native stream/allocator lifetime. The actual library has a bounded native heap and packs output counts into24bits;64KiB input/output windows marshal larger source requests. Initialization and pointer marshalling are browser-owned; the decoder is not reimplemented and no native status/provider is injected. Full zlib initialization-failure/OOM/ABI compatibility remains unqualified and external coverage failure is retained independently. No pako/new download or dependency mutation is needed. The original installed zlib WASM artifact is inlined as a URL so realm-local initialization works in browser and Node test realms before native reads. The zlib ABI and optional direct test bytes are unchanged.
